root_cause: not +Inf: the wrap width was -24. The StyledText measure matches the pin (gpui/styled_text.go:283-293 vs R:elements/text.rs:809-827). In a flex row's min-content pass the padded code-block box (base/text_node_render.go:587) is sized 0, and taffy 0.13 gives its text a known width of 0 - 24 padding without clamping (flexbox.rs:474; the same pinned taffy as upstream). The pin passes Some(-24) through unchecked (R:text_system.rs:350-363) and parley breaks at every opportunity (gpui_ce_parley text_system.rs:917-919, 1116-1117); the port's native service rejects negative widths (reference/native/src/text.rs:1535-1543) and the Go side checked the same, so the frame failed
fix: gpui/text.go nativeWrapWidth raises a negative wrap width to 0 before the native call; ShapeText and WrappedLine.Relayout accept negatives and still reject NaN/Inf. Zero and -24 behave the same in parley (line_break.rs:516-523, 626); the reported width is min(wrap, advance) (R:text_system/line_layout.rs:646-651), clamped to 0 by the measure. No DLL change
